abstract: OBJECTIVE: To study the recurrence rate and predictive factors for recurrence after surgical excision of ovarian mature cystic teratomas (MCT). STUDY DESIGN: Retrospective study of 382 patients who underwent surgical excision of MCT and whose post-surgical follow-up data were available over six months. Patients who underwent concomitant oophorectomy or had a history of oophorectomy were excluded. Medical records were reviewed for evidence of recurrence. The Cox-hazard model was used for the estimation of predictive factors for recurrence. Categorical data were compared using the Chi-square and Fisher's exact tests. RESULTS: There were 16 recurrences within a mean follow-up period of 43.0 months, with a recurrence rate of 4.2%. Young age (<30 years old, Y) (hazard ratio (HR) 2.98; 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.04-8.62, P=0.043), large cyst (≥8 cm in diameter, L) (HR 2.75; 95% CI 1.03-7.37, P=0.044), and bilaterality (B) (HR 2.88; 95% CI 1.07-7.76, P=0.036) were shown to be significant predictive factors. When a patient had all these three factors, the recurrence rate was 21.0%, otherwise 3.4% (P<0.01). Patients with Y+L, Y+B, and B+L also showed significantly higher recurrence rate (21.4%, 15.9%, and 11.4%, respectively). CONCLUSION: The long-term recurrence rate after surgical excision of MCT in this study is 4.2%. A patient with young age (<30 years old) or large cyst (≥8 cm in diameter) or bilateral cysts is at high risk of recurrence, which is even higher when a patient has more than one of these factors.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)の外科的切除後の再発率と再発の予測因子を検討すること。研究デザイン：術後6か月以上の追跡データが得られたMCT切除患者382例の後方視的研究。同時卵巣摘出を受けた患者、または卵巣摘出の既往がある患者は除外した。診療記録を再発の所見について検討し、Cox比例ハザードモデルを用いて再発の予測因子を推定した。カテゴリーデータはカイ二乗検定およびFisher正確検定で比較した。結果：平均追跡期間43.0か月で16例に再発がみられ、再発率は4.2%であった。若年(30歳未満、Y)(ハザード比(HR)2.98、95%信頼区間(CI)1.04-8.62、P=0.043)、大きな嚢胞(直径8cm以上、L)(HR 2.75、95%CI 1.03-7.37、P=0.044)、両側性(B)(HR 2.88、95%CI 1.07-7.76、P=0.036)が有意な予測因子であった。3因子すべてを有する患者の再発率は21.0%で、それ以外は3.4%であった(P<0.01)。Y+L、Y+B、B+Lを有する患者でも再発率が有意に高かった(それぞれ21.4%、15.9%、11.4%)。結論：本研究における外科的切除後MCTの長期再発率は4.2%であった。若年(30歳未満)、大きな嚢胞(直径8cm以上)、または両側性嚢胞を有する患者は再発リスクが高く、これらの因子を複数有する場合にはさらに高くなる。
